translation_en: I got rhinoplasty from Dr. Kim Do-hyun at Seoul Mirae Plastic Surgery 😊 The cost was 3,500,000 KRW (350만원), and they were really kind from the consultation all the way through the surgery. The swelling lasted about 2 weeks, and now I'm at 3 months and the line looks so natural!! Highly recommend 👍
text_ko: 서울미래성형외과에서 김도현 원장님께 코수술 받았어요 😊 비용은 350만원이었고 상담부터 수술까지 정말 친절했습니다. 붓기는 2주 정도 갔고 지금 3개월차인데 라인이 너무 자연스러워요!! 강추합니다 👍

translation_en: I got non-incisional (buried suture) double eyelid surgery at Mirae Plastic Surgery, and it cost 1,200,000 KRW (120만원). Dr. Lee Su-jin performed it, but one side feels like it has come slightly undone, so I booked a revision consultation. The aftercare was just so-so.
text_ko: 미래성형에서 쌍꺼풀 매몰법 했는데 120만원 들었어요. 이수진 원장님이 집도하셨는데 한쪽이 살짝 풀린 느낌이라 재수술 상담 예약했습니다. 사후관리는 그냥 그랬어요.

translation_en: I did a 10-session Pico toning package at Dalbit Dermatology. It's 80,000 KRW (8만원) per session, 800,000 KRW (80만원) in total. My melasma has definitely faded, and there was almost no downtime, so I went straight back to work 🙌
text_ko: 달빛피부과에서 피코토닝 10회 패키지 했어요. 회당 8만원, 총 80만원이에요. 기미가 확실히 옅어졌고 다운타임 거의 없어서 출근도 바로 했어요 🙌

translation_en: I had incisional double eyelid surgery with Dr. Choi Min-ho at Haneulbit Plastic Surgery. The price was 1,800,000 KRW (180만원), the line is crisp, and the scar is barely visible. Next I plan to get under-eye fat repositioning here too.
text_ko: 하늘빛성형외과 최민호 원장님께 절개 쌍꺼풀 수술 받았습니다. 가격은 180만원이었고 라인이 또렷하고 흉도 거의 안 보여요. 다음에 눈밑지방재배치도 여기서 하려고요.

translation_en: I had revision rhinoplasty with Dr. Jung Ha-eun at Sorin Plastic Surgery. It was 5,500,000 KRW (550만원); they removed the silicone and used costal (rib) cartilage. I'm only 1 month in, so there's still some swelling, but I'm satisfied. However, the waiting time was way too long 😢
text_ko: 소린 성형외과 정하은 원장님께 코재수술 받았어요. 550만원이었는데 실리콘 제거하고 늑연골로 했어요. 아직 1개월차라 붓기가 남아있지만 만족해요. 다만 대기시간이 너무 길었어요 😢
